knowledge_points.content: The power conversion efficiency (PCE) of single-layered polymer solar cells based on the PM6 semiconducting polymer and Y6 non-fullerene acceptor reached 18% by the year 2021.
knowledge_points.evidence: The latest development based on PM6 semiconducting polymers and Y6 nonfullerene acceptors offers PCEs of 18% for single-layered solar cells.

knowledge_points.content: Direct arylation polymerization (DArP) offers a more sustainable synthesis route for semiconducting polymers by using metal-catalyzed C-H activation, thereby avoiding toxic transmetallation reagents like organostannane and organoboron used in Stille and Suzuki methods.
knowledge_points.evidence: By circumventing monomer, functionalization with toxic transmetallation reagents such as organostannane and organoboron required for Stille-Migita and SuzukiMiyaura polymerization methods, DArP proceeds through a metal-catalyzed C-H activation pathway.

knowledge_points.content: Lactam-based moieties serve as critical electron-accepting building blocks in donor-acceptor polymers, with prominent examples including diketopyrrolo[3,4-c]pyrrole (DPP), naphthalene diimide (NDI), isoindigo (IID), 2,2-bithiophene-3,3-dicarboximide (BTI), and thieno[3,4-c]pyrrole-4,6-dione (TPD).
knowledge_points.evidence: Lactams are a key moiety in many leading electron acceptors in donor-acceptor semiconducting polymers, such as diketopyrrolo[3,4-c]pyrrole (DPP), naphthalene diimide (NDI), isoindigo (IID), 2,2-bithiophene-3,3-dicarboximide (BTI), and thieno[3,4-c]pyrrole-4,6-dione (TPD).

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of conjugation break spacers (CBS) into the backbone of n-type naphthalene diimide-based (PNDI) polymers significantly reduces chain rigidity, melting points, and glass transition temperatures.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is found that CBS can significantly reduce chain rigidity, melting point, as well as glass transition temperature... for a series n-type naphthalene diimide-based (PNDI) conjugated polymer.

knowledge_points.content: Photonic field-effect transistor (FET) memory devices utilizing PFO-block-POXD conjugated block copolymers can achieve a high memory ratio (ION/IOFF) of approximately 10^5 with data retention stability demonstrated up to 10^4 seconds.
knowledge_points.evidence: By optimizing the POXD content in the block copolymer, a memory ratio (ION/IOFF) of ~10^5 was achieved after 10^4 s, indicating its superior long-term stability and data discernibility.

knowledge_points.content: Incorporating coumarin groups into the side chains of diketopyrrolo[3,4-c]pyrrole (DPP)-based polymers confers both self-healing capabilities and improved thermal stability to the material.
knowledge_points.evidence: Zhang et al. present the use of coumarin groups in the side chains to render healing ability and thermal stability to DPP-based semiconducting polymers.

knowledge_points.content: In mixed ionic-electronic conductors, a threshold of approximately 40% polar side-chains is required to transition the film morphology from an interfacially gated electrolyte to an electrolyte-swelled state.
knowledge_points.evidence: Their simulations recapitulate the nonlinear progression of the morphology from an interfacially gated electrolyte... to an electrolyteswelled morphology after crossing a threshold of approximately 40% polar side-chains.

knowledge_points.content: Covalent modification of EDOT with a 15-crown-5 moiety (PEDOT-Crown) improves adhesion to ITO-coated glass and results in more Faradaic rather than capacitive electrochemical behavior compared to standard PEDOT.
knowledge_points.evidence: Nielsen et al. demonstrate a novel polymerbased on covalently modified EDOT (PEDOT-Crown)... PEDOT-Crown has a wealth of advantageous properties including superior adhesion to ITO... and more Faradaic rather than capacitive behavior.

knowledge_points.content: The structural nature of counterions (anions) in doped regioregular and regiorandom P3HT significantly affects the polaron absorbance, oxidation potential, and ionization energy of the polymer.
knowledge_points.evidence: The authors investigate how counterion structures impact the electrochemical doping ability, oxidation potential, ionization energy, and polaron absorbance of regioregular (rr) and regiorandom (rra) P3HT.

knowledge_points.content: 3D printing of conjugated polymers can be achieved through three primary extrusion processes: direct ink write (DIW), meniscus-guided printing, and electrohydrodynamic printing.
knowledge_points.evidence: It summarizes progress in the emerging field of 3D printed semiconducting polymers using three extrusion-printing processes: direct ink write, meniscus-guided printing, and electrohydrodynamic printing.

knowledge_points.content: Large-scale atomistic molecular dynamics simulations reveal that increasing the length of alkyl segments in conjugation break spacers (CBS) within a DPP polymer backbone leads to more flexible, compact, and mobile polymer chains with lower glass transition temperatures.
knowledge_points.evidence: They discover that longer alkyl segments lead to polymer chains that are more flexible, compact, and mobile, with lower glass transition temperatures for the condensed phase.

knowledge_points.content: The commercialization of polymer-based flexible electronics faces significant hurdles including batch-to-batch variation, lack of precise charge transport models for circuit simulation, and a limited understanding of polymer degradation and device failure modes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The authors point out a few hurdles to overcome... the lack of a precise and universal charge transport model... the lack of reproducibility, as well as batch-to-batch variation... a better understanding of polymer degradation and device failure modes is of necessity.
